3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: It was the night before my trip to Kyrute for the Alliance of Nations meeting.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I had just finished some last-minute preparations in my study. I carefully made my way back towards the palace's residential wing.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: I reached the top floor. Across the hall from my bedchamber, the Queen Mother's door was open a crack.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: I looked in. My mother was standing out on her balcony, her back turned towards me. I heard her whispering softly to herself.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: Grand Wiseman Ignacius' quarters were on the ground floor. I saw light coming out of the keyhole.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: Just before the stairs was the entrance to Vina's room. Through the door, I caught the faint strains of her voice.

14.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
14.text: Press your ear against the door.

15.speaker: Vina Toras
15.text: "Yes, I agree. It seems like an adequate compromise."
15.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllExceptMining"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true) == false)

19.speaker: Vina Toras
19.text: "...No, he hasn't written back yet. Who knows if he's even read it?"

20.speaker: Vina Toras
20.text: "What, are you mad? Of course Father doesn't know anything about it."

21.speaker: Vina Toras
21.text: "...Yes, my love. We'll speak very soon."

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: There was a clunk as she hung up the phone. I moved away from the door and kept walking.

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: She looked startled for a moment, then smiled.

25.speaker: Estela Toras
25.text: "Don't worry about me, darling. You should be resting yourself."

27.speaker: Estela Toras
27.text: "You shouldn't sneak up on an old woman like that."

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: She looked startled for a moment, then smiled.

29.speaker: Estela Toras
29.text: "I'm surprised you're still up. You have a long day ahead of you."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "Of course I am. The Alliance of Nations won't know what hit it."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "Sure. Can I ask you something about Vina?"

32.speaker: Player_Romus
32.text: "Did Father tell you anything about these AN sessions?"

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "Not really. Diplomacy isn't exactly my forte."

35.speaker: Estela Toras
35.text: "We need our land back. No matter what kind of announcement Wiktor Smolak has up his sleeve."

36.speaker: Estela Toras
36.text: "There's nothing to it. Just stand up straight, smile, preach unity and cooperation..."

37.speaker: Estela Toras
37.text: "Oh, you know he was no diplomat."

38.speaker: Estela Toras
38.text: "In fact, I'm not sure he even attended after the Zille agreement. Poor Mr. Esquibel went alone in his stead."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "Enough is enough. He will pay for his disrespect."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "How do you know he's going to make an announcement?"

41.speaker: Estela Toras
41.text: "My whisper networks aren't what they used to be. But wives still talk."

42.speaker: Estela Toras
42.text: "I care for Mr. Esquibel dearly, but he has given Wehlen the benefit of the doubt for too long."

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "I don't want a confrontation. Our countries are on the same side."

45.speaker: Estela Toras
45.text: "And then stab the bastards in the back when they least expect it."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "What has she been doing while I'm at my council meetings?

51.speaker: Player_Romus
51.text: "Did she get up to anything while I was in Pales?

52.speaker: Estela Toras
52.text: "Besides her etiquette classes, I haven't the faintest. She spends a lot of time holed up in her room."

56.speaker: Vina Toras
56.text: "No, I won't talk to him. He's in Kyrute the next few days anyway."

60.speaker: Vina Toras
60.text: "Oh, don't be so blue. Honestly, what were you expecting?"
60.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllExceptMining"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true) == false)

61.speaker: Vina Toras
61.text: "Yes, I know. I was surprised too."

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "Has she told you whether she's seeing someone?"

63.speaker: Player_Romus
63.text: "Would it be crazy if I married her off to Rico?"

64.speaker: Estela Toras
64.text: "Although of course I've heard the same rumors you have."

65.speaker: Estela Toras
65.text: "As far as I could tell, she spent a lot of time holed up in her room."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "It's all just talk. I don't know what's actually happening."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "I think they're more than just rumors."

69.speaker: Estela Toras
69.text: "Then you have a relationship to approve of. Or not."

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: She flicked a bit of ash from her cigarette off the balcony.

71.speaker: Estela Toras
71.text: "I'll tell you this much. The last thing you want to do is forbid her from seeing him."

72.speaker: Estela Toras
72.text: "Come, dear. Did you really think one dance in Sallabes would be enough for those two?"

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "I am the king. If I order her not to see him, she'll have to obey."

75.speaker: Estela Toras
75.text: "You've been talking to your uncle, I see."

76.speaker: Estela Toras
76.text: "You know how your father and I met, don't you?"

78.speaker: Estela Toras
78.text: "Next thing you know, she's throwing all of her influence at the Council to persuade them that a fisherman's daughter is a suitable match for a prince."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Who said anything about forbidding? I *want* them to get together."

81.speaker: Estela Toras
81.text: "After everything the Sazons did to you? To us?"

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "I would never do that. She's allowed to love whomever she wants."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "It's all fine. I've got a plan."

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "Any advice for how to act, then?"

85.speaker: Estela Toras
85.text: "I was referring to Zille, my dear. Or have you forgotten that the handover deadline is imminent?"

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "Actually, I'd rather not discuss this with you. You're not exactly impartial on Zille."

87.speaker: Estela Toras
87.text: "Impartiality won't get you anywhere with Wehlen."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "Lespia will help me out. We have an arrangement."

89.speaker: Estela Toras
89.text: "I say don't stoop to his level. Make him look like the tyrant he is."

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "He wasn't wrong about keeping power within the Toras family."

92.speaker: Player_Romus
92.text: "He was right. Young people can't be trusted to follow their hearts."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "There's a spark between those two, I can tell."

95.speaker: Estela Toras
95.text: "*Especially* after what we've both been through."

99.speaker: Estela Toras
99.text: "Lespia? An odd choice, but I suppose you know best."

100.speaker: Narrator
100.text: It was later than I realized. The halls were dead silent, illuminated only by weak shafts of moonlight through the windows.

101.speaker: Estela Toras
101.text: "There's a spark between me and my doorknob when I wear woolen slippers."

102.speaker: Estela Toras
102.text: "Royal marriages are a balancing act, my dear. You can satisfy the betrotheds or the country, but almost never both."

109.speaker: Estela Toras
109.text: "*Almost*. You were lucky for a while, Romus."

110.speaker: Estela Toras
110.text: "And it's hard to tell which compromise creates more misery."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "I had one more thing I wanted to ask first. About Vina."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "These things take a while, you know."

113.speaker: Estela Toras
113.text: "I couldn't possibly comment on your daughter's affairs. No matter how much gossip is circulating about them."

114.speaker: Estela Toras
114.text: "It's a balancing act, my dear. When it comes to royal marriages, you can satisfy the betrotheds or the country, but almost never both."

118.speaker: Estela Toras
118.text: "*Almost*. You were lucky for a while, Romus."

119.speaker: Estela Toras
119.text: "This particular pairing, though, would satisfy House Toras and no one else."

120.speaker: Estela Toras
120.text: "And it's hard to tell which compromise creates more misery."

121.speaker: Estela Toras
121.text: "That isn't the sort of information a young lady shares with her grandmother."

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: She flicked a bit of ash from her cigarette off the balcony.

126.speaker: Estela Toras
126.text: "In *Rizia*, darling. Have you truly never considered looking to foreign shores?"

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "The supply of suitable, single nobles in Rizia is dwindling. I don't see much of a choice."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "If I have House Toras behind me, I won't need anyone else."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "Hugo and Rico are powerful men. I'm worried about what they'll do if they don't get their way."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "All I'm saying is, I think they would make cute babies."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "Has she been writing letters to anyone?"

134.speaker: Estela Toras
134.text: "Possibly. She does spend a lot of time holed up in her room."

135.speaker: Estela Toras
135.text: "It's the kind of behavior that might make one think she had a new lover."

137.speaker: Estela Toras
137.text: "I can't say I'm surprised. They're both quite good-looking."

138.speaker: Estela Toras
138.text: "This particular match would satisfy your daughter very much. It would also put House Sazon dangerously close to the throne."

139.speaker: Estela Toras
139.text: "It's up to you whether Vina's happiness is worth that."

140.speaker: Estela Toras
140.text: "Speaking of which, how is that muscle-bound lunk of yours proceeding with his investigation?"

144.speaker: Estela Toras
144.text: "Speaking of which, how is that bird of prey on your council proceeding with her investigation?"
144.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_RizianForeignIntelligence_Expanded"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_CompromisingPhoto"] == true) == false)

151.speaker: Estela Toras
151.text: "Speaking of which, how is your lady friend proceeding with her investigation?"
151.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_RizianForeignIntelligence_Expanded"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_CompromisingPhoto"] == true)

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "Hopefully Rico's gambit will buy us some time."

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "The Pales situation has required her full attention."

166.speaker: Estela Toras
166.text: "No? It wouldn't be a bad match, if you ask me."

167.speaker: Estela Toras
167.text: "Do try to keep her in line. The Azaros getting too mixed up with Pales is what lost us Zille in the first place."

168.speaker: Estela Toras
168.text: "I do hope the investigators turn up something we can use."

169.speaker: Estela Toras
169.text: "I meant it as a term of affection. You know I adore that man and his muscles."

170.speaker: Estela Toras
170.text: "At any rate, I hope his investigators turn up something we can use."

171.speaker: Estela Toras
171.text: "She gives you the loyalty of the Azaros, you help curb that legendary Azaro temper..."

172.speaker: Estela Toras
172.text: "I do wish you'd run that by me. If Wehlen finds out we intentionally gave them the wrong suspects, it could blow up in our faces."

173.speaker: Estela Toras
173.text: "Nothing to be done about it now, anyway."

174.speaker: Estela Toras
174.text: "I shudder to think of what might happen if the handover deadline arrives before a culprit is found."

175.speaker: Estela Toras
175.text: "I meant it as a term of affection. She's got a beautiful beak."

176.speaker: Estela Toras
176.text: "I hope she hasn't inherited her family's unhealthy obsession with Pales. She mustn't distract herself from our real problems."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "Don't worry. I'll stay on top of her."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "Pales *is* a real problem, Mother. The situation there could easily spiral out of control."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "Mother, could you perhaps envision minding your own damn business for once?"

182.speaker: Estela Toras
182.text: "Right. Who cares what happens to my homeland when there's embroidery that needs embroidering?"

183.speaker: Narrator
183.text: She forcefully stubbed her cigarette out on the balcony railing.

187.speaker: Estela Toras
187.text: "Has that bird of prey on your council managed to find out anything more about what happened to us in Zille?"
187.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_RizianForeignIntelligence_Expanded"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_CompromisingPhoto"] == true) == false)

188.speaker: Estela Toras
188.text: "Has your new lady friend received any more intelligence from Wehlen?"
188.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_RizianForeignIntelligence_Expanded"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_CompromisingPhoto"] == true)

189.speaker: Estela Toras
189.text: "I should get some rest. And so should you."

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "Don't take that tone with your king."

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "Wait. I'm sorry. You don't understand the stress I'm under."

192.speaker: Estela Toras
192.text: "Pales is not ours to control in the first place. Zille, on the other hand..."

193.speaker: Estela Toras
193.text: "Well. It's about time I got some rest."

194.speaker: Player_Romus
194.text: "Wait. I had one more thing I wanted to ask. About Vina."

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "Please don't worry about Zille. I promise I'm doing everything I can."

197.speaker: Player_Romus
197.text: "Yes, I can see the advantages of such a match. But I haven't made my mind up yet."

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "She's my councilor. It wouldn't be right."

200.speaker: Estela Toras
200.text: "Think about it. She may be past her prime marriage years, but it's not too late for some other noble to snatch her up."

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "Remember how I told you Pabel thinks Father was murdered? Titus is investigating that."

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "Pabel thinks Father might have been murdered. I told Titus to investigate that."

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "If someone killed Father, I might be next."

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "Even if Pabel was wrong about the murder, I'll have gathered some useful intel."

211.speaker: Estela Toras
211.text: "Hmm. You're starting to sound just like him."

212.speaker: Narrator
212.text: She stubbed her cigarette out on the balcony railing and sighed.

213.speaker: Estela Toras
213.text: "I do beg your pardon. Your Majesty."

215.speaker: Narrator
215.text: There was a chill in her voice now.

216.speaker: Estela Toras
216.text: "I know. The last thing you need is pressure from me."

220.speaker: Estela Toras
220.text: "I should hope I'm not on the list of suspects."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "Maybe not, but I've already assigned him the task. I've got to see it through."

226.speaker: Narrator
226.text: I wished her goodnight and left the room. I heard her light click off.

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "Lyza was weak. I know how to control my own daughter."

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "Then what do I do? I don't want him infecting her with his dangerous ideas."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "Thank God. She's warmed up to Rico after all."

230.speaker: Estela Toras
230.text: "Are you sure it's not the opposite you need to be worried about?"

231.speaker: Narrator
231.text: She cast a sidelong glance at me.

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "I actually like the kid. But he doesn't seem like marriage material to me."

236.speaker: Narrator
236.text: She cast a sidelong glance at me.

237.speaker: Estela Toras
237.text: "But... after everything the Sazons did to you? To us?"

238.speaker: Estela Toras
238.text: "No force in this world is as uncontrollable as a young woman in love."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "The Sazons aren't as dangerous as you think. I'm looking to collaborate more closely with Manus, in fact."

242.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
242.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_WorkWithRPP"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_OverthrowMonarchy"] == true) == false

243.speaker: Player_Romus
243.text: "Of course it is, Mother. How could you even ask that?"

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "I'd be fine with it if it were true love. But I'm worried he's using her."

245.speaker: Estela Toras
245.text: "They're powerful within Rizia, but minor players on the global stage."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "It might help neutralize the Sazon threat, actually. Manus' 'man of the people' act won't work if he's king consort."
246.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_WorkWithRPP"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Manus_OverthrowMonarchy"] == true) == false

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "You said yourself I shouldn't forbid her from seeing him. What other choice do I have?"

248.speaker: Estela Toras
248.text: "You need to be thinking bigger, my love. We Torases are but minor players on the global stage."

252.speaker: Narrator
252.text: She cast a sidelong glance at me.

253.speaker: Estela Toras
253.text: "I should think you'd be more worried about putting House Sazon a single body away from the throne."

257.speaker: Estela Toras
257.text: "It is, however, something any woman of experience can tell in seconds."

259.speaker: Estela Toras
259.text: "You could use the pairing to keep a close eye on the opposition. Assuming Vina trusts you enough to pass along information about her paramour's family."

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: "Whatever. There must be some way we can stop this."

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "That's nonsense. She can't even hold a gun."

264.speaker: Estela Toras
264.text: "Nothing. Just wondering if she took more than an academic interest in that book she borrowed a while ago."

265.speaker: Player_Romus
265.text: "If I can't control her, what can I do?"

266.speaker: Estela Toras
266.text: "Love has toppled more empires than gunshots ever will."

267.speaker: Estela Toras
267.text: "You send the princess on a nice, relaxing trip abroad. Nothing cures lovesickness like a change of scenery."

268.speaker: Estela Toras
268.text: "Then you'll have to find a way to make it work to your advantage."

269.speaker: Estela Toras
269.text: "In that case, Vina might be useful as your eyes and ears inside their house."

270.speaker: Estela Toras
270.text: "Yes, there are ways to make this work to your advantage."

277.speaker: Player_Romus
277.text: "No, no. She's my daughter, not a spy."

278.speaker: Estela Toras
278.text: "We're all using each other, aren't we? In fact..."

279.speaker: Estela Toras
279.text: "Or there's one other thing you could do."

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "A diplomatic mission, perhaps? Distract Vina and improve our international standing in one go."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "I can't do that. She's a valuable member of my council."

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "Hmm. She's been cramping my style on the council, it's true."

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "She'd find that a lot more stimulating than etiquette classes, I'm sure."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "I'm not ready to let go of her. She's the last tie to Lena I have left."

288.speaker: Estela Toras
288.text: "You could always invite her high-and-mighty aunt for more scintillating chats over putrid Rumburgian tea."

289.speaker: Estela Toras
289.text: "It's just a thought. Feel free to ignore it."

290.speaker: Estela Toras
290.text: "And if she meets some dashing foreign prince over there, consider it a bonus."

291.speaker: Estela Toras
291.text: "You want my advice? It's high time the Princess took a nice, relaxing trip out of the country."

295.speaker: Estela Toras
295.text: "It would put a stop to the rumors that are beginning to circulate about Her Highness and the Sazon heir."

296.speaker: Estela Toras
296.text: "She's old enough to experience the world beyond our little peninsula."

297.speaker: Estela Toras
297.text: "Speaking of foreign affairs, are you positive you don't want to talk about tomorrow's meeting? I just want to make sure you're prepared to address the elephant in the chamber."

298.speaker: Estela Toras
298.text: "And with that, it's time to turn in."

300.speaker: Estela Toras
300.text: "I hope Pabel ironed your pillowcase. You can't go addressing the AN with creases on your face."

308.speaker: Player_Romus
308.text: "I'll deal with that when the moment arrives. I've got enough to think about for tonight."

313.speaker: Player_Romus
313.text: "Don't worry about Vina. I know what to do."

314.speaker: Estela Toras
314.text: "It's late, isn't it? Time to turn in."

315.speaker: Estela Toras
315.text: "You're her father *and* the king. You surely know best."

323.speaker: Narrator
323.text: I returned to my quarters to see Titus take his post outside my door. I wondered how long he'd been shadowing me for.

327.speaker: Narrator
327.text: I checked the corner for Bruno, but his dog bed was empty. I looked at my own bed and saw that he'd made himself comfortable there.

329.speaker: Player_Romus
329.text: "Get a move on, boy. The King needs his rest."

330.speaker: Player_Romus
330.text: "All right. You can sleep here tonight, but don't get too used to it."

331.speaker: Narrator
331.text: Bruno curled up at my feet as I got in bed.

332.speaker: Narrator
332.text: Bruno reluctantly hopped off the bed and trotted back to his corner. He was nearly as agile on three legs as he'd been on four.

333.speaker: Narrator
333.text: I tried to sleep, but was too distracted by thoughts of the day ahead.

334.speaker: Narrator
334.text: I climbed into bed, but was too distracted by thoughts of the day ahead to sleep.

341.speaker: Player_Romus
341.text: "Thank you for your concern. But I have it all under control."

343.speaker: Player_Romus
343.text: "If this doesn't work, we'll try something else. But Zille *will* be ours."

347.speaker: Estela Toras
347.text: "You are planning on addressing the elephant in the chamber, aren't you?"

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "Of course I am. Wehlen must be forced to honor the Zille handover deadline."

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "Certainly. This naval standoff with Pales must end one way or another."

354.speaker: Player_Romus
354.text: "Yes, the arbitration committee should have come to a decision already. Our claim on the gas field is clear."

359.speaker: Estela Toras
359.text: "A wonder that you world leaders can squeeze in amongst all those pachyderms."

360.speaker: Estela Toras
360.text: "But I was referring to Zille. Or have you forgotten that the handover deadline is imminent?"

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "There is no elephant. I've neutralized the Pales situation for now."

362.speaker: Estela Toras
362.text: "Have you so quickly forgotten? The Zille handover deadline is almost upon us."

363.speaker: Player_Romus
363.text: "Duchess Azaro has a level head. She won't drag us into conflict without reason."

367.speaker: Estela Toras
367.text: "Don't forget what happened when Lyza the Great tried to forbid your father from seeing the Whore of Zille."

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "You were working as a waitress in a cocktail bar."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "You used your feminine wiles to entrap him."

371.speaker: Player_Romus
371.text: "I was always confused about that. Why did Lyza allow Father to date a commoner?"

372.speaker: Estela Toras
372.text: "She didn't, at first. But the more she tried to discourage him, the faster she drove him straight into the arms of the Whore of Zille."

374.speaker: Estela Toras
374.text: "It was only supposed to be a fling, at first. But when Lyza the Great caught wind of it, she did everything in her considerable power to stop her son from seeing me."

375.speaker: Estela Toras
375.text: "And that, of course, was what drove him straight into the arms of the Whore of Zille."

376.speaker: Player_Romus
376.text: "Everything worked out in the end, though, didn't it?"

377.speaker: Estela Toras
377.text: "If you call seriously undermining the monarchy 'working out', then yes."

378.speaker: Narrator
378.text: In my room. Pabel had already packed my suitcase and turned the bed down.

379.speaker: Vina Toras
379.text: "Well, tell the others not to push for too much too quickly. He's in Kyrute the next few days anyway."

385.speaker: Vina Toras
385.text: "What?! Why would you want to stop when you only got half of what you wanted? That's no victory at all."
385.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllExceptMining"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true) == false)

392.speaker: Vina Toras
392.text: "Oh, don't be so blue. Honestly, what were you expecting?"
392.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllExceptMining"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_WorkersRightsAllIndustries"] == true) == false)

393.speaker: Vina Toras
393.text: "It's just the beginning, isn't it? You've won this victory, now you've got to keep pushing for more."

394.speaker: Estela Toras
394.text: "Darling, sometimes a heart attack is just a heart attack. No need to waste the man's time trying to figure out who was where when."

396.speaker: Narrator
396.text: She looked startled for a moment, then smiled.

397.speaker: Estela Toras
397.text: "Just rehearsing the choice words I'm going to have with the royal laundress. How hard can it be to get red wine out of an albino fox stole?"

398.speaker: Narrator
398.text: She lit a cigarette and blew smoke out into the gardens.
